name: moodle-teacher
description: The teacher's half of Moodle: who is enrolled, who submitted, what is missing, marking with feedback, announcements.
long_description: Connects your Moodle to Claude from the teacher's seat rather than the student's. Reading: enrolments, course contents, assignments, submissions with their files, who has not handed in, the gradebook. Writing: a mark with written feedback on one submission, and an announcement in the course news forum. Needs a Moodle web-service token, which you get from Preferences > Security keys on your Moodle, or from your Moodle administrator.

moodle_url.title: Moodle web service address
moodle_url.description: Your Moodle address followed by /webservice/rest/server.php — for example https://moodle.example.edu/webservice/rest/server.php. Use the exact host your Moodle knows itself by (with or without www).

moodle_token.title: Moodle token
moodle_token.description: From your Moodle: Preferences > Security keys > Moodle mobile web service. If that page is empty, ask your Moodle administrator for a token.
